How the Fully Autonomous Mobilator Moves & Works on the Disney Adventure
Disney Live Entertainment was able to bring their first fully autonomous computer driven character to life onboard Disney Cruise Line with the Mobilator - which you can see in "Remember: A Disney & Pixar Stage Show" on the Disney Adventure!

✨ What makes this special?
• The mobilator is fully autonomous and computer driven while including a ramp for additional characters to move freely
• It uses LIDAR, cameras, and wheel odometry to know where it's at on stage
